To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

epoxy/POSS nanostructured composites exhibit enhanced dielectric and thermal insulation properties, which can be explained by the molecular dispersion of POSS in the matrix, as well as the formation of interfacial layers between POSS and the epoxy matrix.

the addition of a reactive Trigylcidylisobuty-POSS (POSS) to an epoxy system can significantly enhance its dielectric and thermal performance, while the POSS additive is molecularly dispersed for low content composities.
epoxy/POSS nanocomposites show improved dielectric and thermal performance, and the POSS additive can be successfully incorporated in epoxy at a low content.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a nanostructured epoxy/Triglycidyl-POSS composite material, which exhibits improved dielectric breakdown strength, thermal conductivity and resistance to corona erosion.
the development of a novel class of epoxy composites with improved electrical, thermal and mechanical properties, which are promising for high voltage insulation application.
nanostructured epoxy/Triglycidyl-POSS composites with improved properties for high voltage insulation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of TGIB-POSS to epoxy resin results in improved dielectric breakdown strength and thermal conductivity, but also in increased corona resistance.
the addition of POSS to epoxy leads to an increase of the thermal conductivity and a decrease in the dielectric loss factor, but only at low contents of POSS.

epoxy/POSS nanocomposites show an enhanced performance for high voltage applications, with a maximum improvement of up to 60 % less eroded sample area for 5 wt% TGIB-POSS, and a significantly increased dielectric strength for 1 and 3 wt% POSS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the addition of a small amount of TGIB-POSS additive to the epoxy matrix leads to a significant improvement of the dielectric and electrical properties, which makes these composites promising for high voltage insulation materials.
the incorporation of a low amount of POSS into epoxy results in improved electrical, thermal and mechanical properties of the composites.

the addition of a reactive POSS additive at low concentrations to an epoxy system can result in a significant improvement of the dielectric and corona resistance, which can be explained by a molecular-level dispersion of the additive.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of 1 wt% of TGIB-POSS to an epoxy resin results in a composite with enhanced dielectric, thermal, and corona resistance properties.
the addition of a low amount of POSS additive to an epoxy resin leads to the formation of a highly efficient nanocomposite with improved thermal, dielectric and corona resistance properties.

the dielectric and electrical breakdown properties of epoxy composites can be significantly improved by the addition of a small amount of reactive POSS, while the thermal properties are only slightly affected.
